14. import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory
15. import kotlin.reflect.KClass
16. 
17. /**
18.  * Parses a GraphQL Schema and maps object fields to provided class methods.
19.  *
20.  * @author Andrew Potter
21.  */
22. class SchemaParser internal constructor(
23.     scanResult: ScannedSchemaObjects,
24.     private val options: SchemaParserOptions,
25.     private val runtimeWiring: RuntimeWiring
26. ) {
27.     private val log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(javaClass)
28. 
29.     companion object {
30.         @JvmStatic
31.         fun newParser() = SchemaParserBuilder()
32.     }
33. 
34.     private val dictionary = scanResult.dictionary
35.     private val definitions = scanResult.definitions
36.     private val customScalars = scanResult.customScalars
37.     private val rootInfo = scanResult.rootInfo
38.     private val fieldResolversByType = scanResult.fieldResolversByType
39.     private val unusedDefinitions = scanResult.unusedDefinitions
40. 
41.     private val extensionDefinitions = definitions.filterIsInstance<ObjectTypeExtensionDefinition>()
42.     private val inputExtensionDefinitions = definitions.filterIsInstance<InputObjectTypeExtensionDefinition>()
43. 
44.     private val objectDefinitions = (definitions.filterIsInstance<ObjectTypeDefinition>() - extensionDefinitions)
45.     private val inputObjectDefinitions = (definitions.filterIsInstance<InputObjectTypeDefinition>() - inputExtensionDefinitions)
46.     private val enumDefinitions = definitions.filterIsInstance<EnumTypeDefinition>()
47.     private val interfaceDefinitions = definitions.filterIsInstance<InterfaceTypeDefinition>()
48. 
49.     private val unionDefinitions = definitions.filterIsInstance<UnionTypeDefinition>()
50. 
51.     private val permittedTypesForObject: Set<String> = (objectDefinitions.map { it.name } +
52.         enumDefinitions.map { it.name } +
53.         interfaceDefinitions.map { it.name } +
54.         unionDefinitions.map { it.name }).toSet()
55.     private val permittedTypesForInputObject: Set<String> =
56.         (inputObjectDefinitions.map { it.name } + enumDefinitions.map { it.name }).toSet()
57. 
58.     private val codeRegistryBuilder = GraphQLCodeRegistry.newCodeRegistry()
59. 
60.     private val schemaGeneratorDirectiveHelper = SchemaGeneratorDirectiveHelper()
61.     private val schemaDirectiveParameters = SchemaGeneratorDirectiveHelper.Parameters(null, runtimeWiring, null, codeRegistryBuilder)
62. 
63.     /**
64.      * Parses the given schema with respect to the given dictionary and returns GraphQL objects.
65.      */
66.     fun parseSchemaObjects(): SchemaObjects {
67.         if (!options.introspectionEnabled) {
68.             codeRegistryBuilder.fieldVisibility(NoIntrospectionGraphqlFieldVisibility.NO_INTROSPECTION_FIELD_VISIBILITY)
69.         }
70.         // this overrides the above introspection enabled setting obviously... todo: add documentation
71.         options.fieldVisibility?.let { codeRegistryBuilder.fieldVisibility(it) }
72. 
73.         // Create GraphQL objects
74.         val inputObjects: MutableList<GraphQLInputObjectType> = mutableListOf()
75.         inputObjectDefinitions.forEach {
76.             if (inputObjects.none { io -> io.name == it.name }) {
77.                 inputObjects.add(createInputObject(it, inputObjects, mutableSetOf()))
78.             }
79.         }
80.         val interfaces = interfaceDefinitions.map { createInterfaceObject(it, inputObjects) }
81.         val objects = objectDefinitions.map { createObject(it, interfaces, inputObjects) }
82.         val unions = unionDefinitions.map { createUnionObject(it, objects) }
83.         val enums = enumDefinitions.map { createEnumObject(it) }
84. 
85.         // Assign type resolver to interfaces now that we know all of the object types
86.         interfaces.forEach { codeRegistryBuilder.typeResolver(it, InterfaceTypeResolver(dictionary.inverse(), it)) }
87.         unions.forEach { codeRegistryBuilder.typeResolver(it, UnionTypeResolver(dictionary.inverse(), it)) }
88. 
89.         // Find query type and mutation/subscription type (if mutation/subscription type exists)
90.         val queryName = rootInfo.getQueryName()
91.         val mutationName = rootInfo.getMutationName()
92.         val subscriptionName = rootInfo.getSubscriptionName()
93. 
94.         val query = objects.find { it.name == queryName }
95.             ?: throw SchemaError("Expected a Query object with name '$queryName' but found none!")
96.         val mutation = objects.find { it.name == mutationName }
97.             ?: if (rootInfo.isMutationRequired()) throw SchemaError("Expected a Mutation object with name '$mutationName' but found none!") else null
98.         val subscription = objects.find { it.name == subscriptionName }
99.             ?: if (rootInfo.isSubscriptionRequired()) throw SchemaError("Expected a Subscription object with name '$subscriptionName' but found none!") else null
100. 
101.         val additionalObjects = objects.filter { o -> o != query && o != subscription && o != mutation }
102. 
103.         val types = (additionalObjects.toSet() as Set<GraphQLType>) + inputObjects + enums + interfaces + unions
104. 
105.         // Collect directive definitions from the type registry/AST
106.         val directiveDefinitions = definitions.filterIsInstance<DirectiveDefinition>()
107.         val additionalDirectives = directiveDefinitions.map { directiveDef ->
108.             val builder = GraphQLDirective.newDirective()
109.                 .name(directiveDef.name)
110.                 .description(getDocumentation(directiveDef, options))
111.                 .repeatable(directiveDef.isRepeatable)
112.                 .validLocations(*directiveDef.directiveLocations.map { loc ->
113.                     Introspection.DirectiveLocation.valueOf(loc.name)
114.                 }.toTypedArray())
115. 
116.             directiveDef.inputValueDefinitions.forEach { argDef ->
117.                 val argumentBuilder = GraphQLArgument.newArgument()
118.                     .name(argDef.name)
119.                     .definition(argDef)
120.                     .description(getDocumentation(argDef, options))
121.                     .type(determineInputType(argDef.type, inputObjects, setOf()))
122.                     .apply { argDef.defaultValue?.let { defaultValueLiteral(it) } }
123.                     .withDirectives(*buildDirectives(argDef.directives, Introspection.DirectiveLocation.ARGUMENT_DEFINITION))
124.                     .withAppliedDirectives(*buildAppliedDirectives(argDef.directives))
125.                 builder.argument(argumentBuilder.build())
126.             }
127. 
128.             builder.build()
129.         }.toSet()
130. 
131.         return SchemaObjects(query, mutation, subscription, types, codeRegistryBuilder, rootInfo.getDescription(), additionalDirectives)
132.     }

135.      * Parses the given schema with respect to the given dictionary and returns a GraphQLSchema
136.      */
137.     fun makeExecutableSchema(): GraphQLSchema = parseSchemaObjects().toSchema()

145.     private fun createObject(objectDefinition: ObjectTypeDefinition, interfaces: List<GraphQLInterfaceType>, inputObjects: List<GraphQLInputObjectType>): GraphQLObjectType {
146.         val name = objectDefinition.name
147.         val builder = GraphQLObjectType.newObject()
148.             .name(name)
149.             .definition(objectDefinition)
150.             .description(getDocumentation(objectDefinition, options))
151. 
152.         builder.withDirectives(*buildDirectives(objectDefinition.directives, Introspection.DirectiveLocation.OBJECT))
153.         builder.withAppliedDirectives(*buildAppliedDirectives(objectDefinition.directives))
154. 
155.         objectDefinition.implements.forEach { implementsDefinition ->
156.             val interfaceName = (implementsDefinition as TypeName).name
157.             builder.withInterface(interfaces.find { it.name == interfaceName }
158.                 ?: throw SchemaError("Expected interface type with name '$interfaceName' but found none!"))
159.         }
160. 
161.         objectDefinition.getExtendedFieldDefinitions(extensionDefinitions).forEach { fieldDefinition ->
162.             builder.field { field ->
163.                 createField(field, fieldDefinition, inputObjects)
164.                 codeRegistryBuilder.dataFetcher(
165.                     FieldCoordinates.coordinates(objectDefinition.name, fieldDefinition.name),
166.                     fieldResolversByType[objectDefinition]?.get(fieldDefinition)?.createDataFetcher()
167.                         ?: throw SchemaError("No resolver method found for object type '${objectDefinition.name}' and field '${fieldDefinition.name}', this is most likely a bug with graphql-java-tools")
168.                 )
169. 
170.                 val wiredField = field.build()
171.                 GraphQLFieldDefinition.Builder(wiredField)
172.                     .clearArguments()
173.                     .arguments(wiredField.arguments)
174.             }
175.         }
176. 
177.         val objectType = builder.build()
178.         val directiveHelperParameters = SchemaGeneratorDirectiveHelper.Parameters(null, runtimeWiring, null, codeRegistryBuilder)
179. 
180.         return schemaGeneratorDirectiveHelper.onObject(objectType, directiveHelperParameters)
181.     }

183.     private fun createInputObject(definition: InputObjectTypeDefinition, inputObjects: List<GraphQLInputObjectType>,
184.                                   referencingInputObjects: MutableSet<String>): GraphQLInputObjectType {
185.         val extensionDefinitions = inputExtensionDefinitions.filter { it.name == definition.name }
186. 
187.         val builder = GraphQLInputObjectType.newInputObject()
188.             .name(definition.name)
189.             .definition(definition)
190.             .extensionDefinitions(extensionDefinitions)
191.             .description(getDocumentation(definition, options))
192. 
193.         builder.withDirectives(*buildDirectives(definition.directives, Introspection.DirectiveLocation.INPUT_OBJECT))
194.         builder.withAppliedDirectives(*buildAppliedDirectives(definition.directives))
195. 
196.         referencingInputObjects.add(definition.name)
197. 
198.         (extensionDefinitions + definition).forEach {
199.             it.inputValueDefinitions.forEach { inputDefinition ->
200.                 val fieldBuilder = GraphQLInputObjectField.newInputObjectField()
201.                     .name(inputDefinition.name)
202.                     .definition(inputDefinition)
203.                     .description(getDocumentation(inputDefinition, options))
204.                     .apply { inputDefinition.defaultValue?.let { v -> defaultValueLiteral(v) } }
205.                     .type(determineInputType(inputDefinition.type, inputObjects, referencingInputObjects))
206.                     .withDirectives(*buildDirectives(inputDefinition.directives, Introspection.DirectiveLocation.INPUT_FIELD_DEFINITION))
207.                     .withAppliedDirectives(*buildAppliedDirectives(inputDefinition.directives))
208.                 builder.field(fieldBuilder.build())
209.             }
210.         }
211. 
212.         return schemaGeneratorDirectiveHelper.onInputObjectType(builder.build(), schemaDirectiveParameters)
213.     }

215.     private fun createEnumObject(definition: EnumTypeDefinition): GraphQLEnumType {
216.         val name = definition.name
217.         val type = dictionary[definition]
218.             ?: throw SchemaError("Expected enum with name '$name' but found none!")
219.         if (!type.unwrap().isEnum) throw SchemaError("Type '$name' is declared as an enum in the GraphQL schema but is not a Java enum!")
220. 
221.         val builder = GraphQLEnumType.newEnum()
222.             .name(name)
223.             .definition(definition)
224.             .description(getDocumentation(definition, options))
225. 
226.         builder.withDirectives(*buildDirectives(definition.directives, Introspection.DirectiveLocation.ENUM))
227.         builder.withAppliedDirectives(*buildAppliedDirectives(definition.directives))
228. 
229.         definition.enumValueDefinitions.forEach { enumDefinition ->
230.             val enumName = enumDefinition.name
231.             val enumValue = type.unwrap().enumConstants.find { (it as Enum<*>).name == enumName }
232.                 ?: throw SchemaError("Expected value for name '$enumName' in enum '${type.unwrap().simpleName}' but found none!")
233. 
234.             val enumValueDirectives = buildDirectives(enumDefinition.directives, Introspection.DirectiveLocation.ENUM_VALUE)
235.             getDeprecated(enumDefinition.directives).let {
236.                 val enumValueDefinition = GraphQLEnumValueDefinition.newEnumValueDefinition()
237.                     .name(enumName)
238.                     .description(getDocumentation(enumDefinition, options))
239.                     .value(enumValue)
240.                     .deprecationReason(it)
241.                     .withDirectives(*enumValueDirectives)
242.                     .withAppliedDirectives(*buildAppliedDirectives(enumDefinition.directives))
243.                     .definition(enumDefinition)
244.                     .build()
245. 
246.                 builder.value(enumValueDefinition)
247.             }
248.         }
249. 
250.         return schemaGeneratorDirectiveHelper.onEnum(builder.build(), schemaDirectiveParameters)
251.     }

254.         val name = interfaceDefinition.name

263.         interfaceDefinition.fieldDefinitions.forEach { fieldDefinition ->

275.     private fun createUnionObject(definition: UnionTypeDefinition, types: List<GraphQLObjectType>): GraphQLUnionType {
276.         val name = definition.name
277.         val builder = GraphQLUnionType.newUnionType()
278.             .name(name)
279.             .definition(definition)

289.     private fun getLeafUnionObjects(definition: UnionTypeDefinition, types: List<GraphQLObjectType>): List<GraphQLObjectType> {
290.         val name = definition.name
291.         val leafObjects = mutableListOf<GraphQLObjectType>()
292. 
293.         definition.memberTypes.forEach {
294.             val typeName = (it as TypeName).name
295. 
296.             // Is this a nested union? If so, expand
297.             val nestedUnion: UnionTypeDefinition? = unionDefinitions.find { otherDefinition -> typeName == otherDefinition.name }
298. 
299.             if (nestedUnion != null) {
300.                 leafObjects.addAll(getLeafUnionObjects(nestedUnion, types))
301.             } else {
302.                 leafObjects.add(types.find { type -> type.name == typeName }
303.                     ?: throw SchemaError("Expected object type '$typeName' for union type '$name', but found none!"))
304.             }
305.         }
306.         return leafObjects
307.     }

309.     private fun createField(field: GraphQLFieldDefinition.Builder, fieldDefinition: FieldDefinition, inputObjects: List<GraphQLInputObjectType>): GraphQLFieldDefinition.Builder {
310.         field
311.             .name(fieldDefinition.name)
312.             .description(getDocumentation(fieldDefinition, options))
313.             .definition(fieldDefinition)
314.             .apply { getDeprecated(fieldDefinition.directives)?.let { deprecate(it) } }
315.             .type(determineOutputType(fieldDefinition.type, inputObjects))
316. 
317.         fieldDefinition.inputValueDefinitions.forEach { argumentDefinition ->
318.             val argumentBuilder = GraphQLArgument.newArgument()
319.                 .name(argumentDefinition.name)
320.                 .definition(argumentDefinition)
321.                 .description(getDocumentation(argumentDefinition, options))
322.                 .type(determineInputType(argumentDefinition.type, inputObjects, setOf()))
323.                 .apply { argumentDefinition.defaultValue?.let { defaultValueLiteral(it) } }
324.                 .withDirectives(*buildDirectives(argumentDefinition.directives, Introspection.DirectiveLocation.ARGUMENT_DEFINITION))
325.                 .withAppliedDirectives(*buildAppliedDirectives(argumentDefinition.directives))
326. 
327.             field.argument(argumentBuilder.build())
328.         }
329.         field.withDirectives(*buildDirectives(fieldDefinition.directives, Introspection.DirectiveLocation.FIELD_DEFINITION))
330.         field.withAppliedDirectives(*buildAppliedDirectives(fieldDefinition.directives))

332.         return field

335.     private fun buildDirectives(directives: List<Directive>, directiveLocation: Introspection.DirectiveLocation): Array<GraphQLDirective> {
336.         val names = mutableSetOf<String>()
337. 
338.         val output = mutableListOf<GraphQLDirective>()
339.         for (directive in directives) {
340.             if (!names.contains(directive.name)) {
341.                 names.add(directive.name)
342.                 val graphQLDirective = GraphQLDirective.newDirective()
343.                     .name(directive.name)
344.                     .description(getDocumentation(directive, options))
345.                     .comparatorRegistry(runtimeWiring.comparatorRegistry)
346.                     .validLocation(directiveLocation)
347.                     .apply {
348.                         directive.arguments.forEach { arg ->
349.                             argument(GraphQLArgument.newArgument()
350.                                 .name(arg.name)
351.                                 .type(buildDirectiveInputType(arg.value))
352.                                 .valueLiteral(arg.value)
353.                                 .build())
354.                         }
355.                     }
356.                     .build()
357. 
358.                 output.add(graphQLDirective)
359.             }
360.         }
361. 
362.         return output.toTypedArray()
363.     }

366.         val names = mutableSetOf<String>()

369.         for (directive in directives) {

374.                     .description(getDocumentation(directive, options))
375. 
376.                 directive.arguments.forEach { arg ->
377.                     val argBuilder = GraphQLAppliedDirectiveArgument.newArgument()
378.                         .name(arg.name)
379.                         .type(buildDirectiveInputType(arg.value))
380.                         .valueLiteral(arg.value)
381.                     builder.argument(argBuilder.build())

391.     private fun buildDirectiveInputType(value: Value<*>): GraphQLInputType? {
392.         when (value) {
393.             is NullValue -> return Scalars.GraphQLString
394.             is FloatValue -> return Scalars.GraphQLFloat
395.             is StringValue -> return Scalars.GraphQLString
396.             is IntValue -> return Scalars.GraphQLInt
397.             is BooleanValue -> return Scalars.GraphQLBoolean
398.             is ArrayValue -> return GraphQLList.list(buildDirectiveInputType(getArrayValueWrappedType(value)))
399.             else -> throw SchemaError("Directive values of type '${value::class.simpleName}' are not supported yet.")
400.         }
401.     }
402. 
403.     private fun getArrayValueWrappedType(value: ArrayValue): Value<*> {
404.         // empty array [] is equivalent to [null]
405.         if (value.values.isEmpty()) {
406.             return NullValue.newNullValue().build()
407.         }
408. 
409.         // get rid of null values
410.         val nonNullValueList = value.values.filter { v -> v !is NullValue }
411. 
412.         // [null, null, ...] unwrapped is null
413.         if (nonNullValueList.isEmpty()) {
414.             return NullValue.newNullValue().build()
415.         }
416. 
417.         // make sure the array isn't polymorphic
418.         val distinctTypes = nonNullValueList
419.             .map { it::class.java }
420.             .distinct()
421. 
422.         if (distinctTypes.size > 1) {
423.             throw SchemaError("Arrays containing multiple types of values are not supported yet.")
424.         }
425. 
426.         // peek at first value, value exists and is assured to be non-null
427.         return nonNullValueList[0]
428.     }

433.     private fun <T : Any> determineType(expectedType: KClass<T>, typeDefinition: Type<*>, allowedTypeReferences: Set<String>, inputObjects: List<GraphQLInputObjectType>): GraphQLType =
434.         when (typeDefinition) {
435.             is ListType -> GraphQLList(determineType(expectedType, typeDefinition.type, allowedTypeReferences, inputObjects))
436.             is NonNullType -> GraphQLNonNull(determineType(expectedType, typeDefinition.type, allowedTypeReferences, inputObjects))
437.             is InputObjectTypeDefinition -> {
438.                 log.info("Create input object")
439.                 createInputObject(typeDefinition, inputObjects, mutableSetOf())
440.             }
441.             is TypeName -> {
442.                 val scalarType = customScalars[typeDefinition.name]
443.                     ?: GRAPHQL_SCALARS[typeDefinition.name]
444.                 if (scalarType != null) {
445.                     scalarType
446.                 } else {
447.                     if (!allowedTypeReferences.contains(typeDefinition.name)) {
448.                         throw SchemaError("Expected type '${typeDefinition.name}' to be a ${expectedType.simpleName}, but it wasn't!  " +
449.                             "Was a type only permitted for object types incorrectly used as an input type, or vice-versa?")
450.                     }
451.                     inputObjects.find { it.name == typeDefinition.name } ?: GraphQLTypeReference(typeDefinition.name)
452.                 }
453.             }
454.             else -> throw SchemaError("Unknown type: $typeDefinition")
455.         }

457.     private fun determineInputType(typeDefinition: Type<*>, inputObjects: List<GraphQLInputObjectType>, referencingInputObjects: Set<String>) =
458.         determineInputType(GraphQLInputType::class, typeDefinition, permittedTypesForInputObject, inputObjects, referencingInputObjects)
459. 
460.     private fun <T : Any> determineInputType(expectedType: KClass<T>,
461.                                              typeDefinition: Type<*>, allowedTypeReferences: Set<String>,
462.                                              inputObjects: List<GraphQLInputObjectType>,
463.                                              referencingInputObjects: Set<String>): GraphQLInputType =
464.         when (typeDefinition) {
465.             is ListType -> GraphQLList(determineType(expectedType, typeDefinition.type, allowedTypeReferences, inputObjects))
466.             is NonNullType -> GraphQLNonNull(determineType(expectedType, typeDefinition.type, allowedTypeReferences, inputObjects))
467.             is InputObjectTypeDefinition -> {
468.                 log.info("Create input object")
469.                 createInputObject(typeDefinition, inputObjects, referencingInputObjects as MutableSet<String>)
470.             }
471.             is TypeName -> {
472.                 val scalarType = customScalars[typeDefinition.name]
473.                     ?: GRAPHQL_SCALARS[typeDefinition.name]
474.                 if (scalarType != null) {
475.                     scalarType
476.                 } else {
477.                     if (!allowedTypeReferences.contains(typeDefinition.name)) {
478.                         throw SchemaError("Expected type '${typeDefinition.name}' to be a ${expectedType.simpleName}, but it wasn't!  " +
479.                             "Was a type only permitted for object types incorrectly used as an input type, or vice-versa?")
480.                     }
481.                     val found = inputObjects.filter { it.name == typeDefinition.name }
482.                     if (found.size == 1) {
483.                         found[0]
484.                     } else {
485.                         val filteredDefinitions = inputObjectDefinitions.filter { it.name == typeDefinition.name }
486.                         if (filteredDefinitions.isNotEmpty()) {
487.                             val referencingInputObject = referencingInputObjects.find { it == typeDefinition.name }
488.                             if (referencingInputObject != null) {
489.                                 GraphQLTypeReference(referencingInputObject)
490.                             } else {
491.                                 val inputObject = createInputObject(filteredDefinitions[0], inputObjects, referencingInputObjects as MutableSet<String>)
492.                                 (inputObjects as MutableList).add(inputObject)
493.                                 inputObject
494.                             }
495.                         } else {
496.                             // todo: handle enum type
497.                             GraphQLTypeReference(typeDefinition.name)
498.                         }
499.                     }
500.                 }
501.             }
502.             else -> throw SchemaError("Unknown type: $typeDefinition")
503.         }

505.     /**
506.      * Returns an optional [String] describing a deprecated field/enum.
507.      * If a deprecation directive was defined using the @deprecated directive,
508.      * then a String containing either the contents of the 'reason' argument, if present, or a default
509.      * message defined in [DEFAULT_DEPRECATION_MESSAGE] will be returned. Otherwise, `null` will be returned
510.      * indicating no deprecation directive was found within the directives list.
511.      */
512.     private fun getDeprecated(directives: List<Directive>): String? =
513.         getDirective(directives, "deprecated")?.let { directive ->
514.             (directive.arguments.find { it.name == "reason" }?.value as? StringValue)?.value
515.                 ?: DEFAULT_DEPRECATION_MESSAGE
516.         }
517. 
518.     private fun getDirective(directives: List<Directive>, name: String): Directive? = directives.find {
519.         it.name == name
520.     }
521. }

523. class SchemaError(message: String, cause: Throwable? = null) : RuntimeException(message, cause)
524. 
525. val GRAPHQL_SCALARS = ScalarInfo.GRAPHQL_SPECIFICATION_SCALARS.associateBy { it.name }
526. 
527. const val DEFAULT_DEPRECATION_MESSAGE = "No longer supported"
